description: A free S3-compatible object store: buckets, objects, multipart, presigned URLs, SigV4; slow reads, SlowDown and missing keys as scenarios.
name: s3-mock

settings.description: Milliseconds every GetObject waits before it answers (a slow read).
settings.name: get_latency_ms

settings.description: Answer every request 503 SlowDown, S3's throttling error.
settings.name: slow_down

settings.description: Answer every request with this status and a matching S3 XML error; 0 is off.
settings.name: error_status

settings.description: Object keys that start with this prefix answer NoSuchKey on GET and HEAD, whatever is stored; empty is off.
settings.name: missing_key_prefix

settings.description: Smallest size of a multipart part that is not the last; S3's own rule is 5242880.
settings.name: min_part_bytes

settings.description: The access key id the scope's requests must be signed with (fictional default).
settings.name: access_key_id

settings.description: The secret access key the scope verifies signatures with (fictional default). Never logged, never in an event.
settings.name: secret_access_key
